 Appearance:
 DARSHIT R BRAHMBHATT(8011) for the Applicant(s) No. 1,2  DIPTESH R BRAHMBHATT(8407) for the Applicant(s) No. 1,2  MR HR PRAJAPATI(674) for the Respondent(s) No. 2  MS VRUNDA SHAH, APP for the Respondent(s) No. 1  ==========================================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE M. R. MENGDEY  Date : 02/12/2025

Present application is preferred by the petitioners under Article 226 of the Constitution of India seeking quashing of FIR No.I-89 of 2017 dated 18.06.2017 registered with Vidhyanagar Police Station, Anand for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506(2) and 114 of the Indian Penal Code, Sections 3 and 7 of the Dowry Prohibition Act and Section 3(1)(R) (S) of the Atrocities Act.

2. Heard learned Advocate for the petitioners and learned APP for the Respondent - State.
3.
Rule. Learned APP waives service of notice for and on behalf of the respondent - State.

4. Learned Advocate for the petitioners has submitted that the matter has been amicably settled between the parties and NEUTRAL CITATION R/SCR.A/4750/2017 ORDER DATED: 02/12/2025 Dignesh Kaushikbhai Desai vs State Of Gujarat on 2 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/3730098/

sentences.text: they are now not willing to proceed with the complaint any further.
5. Leaned Advocate Mr. HR Prajapati appearing on behalf of Respondent No.2 (Original Complainant) has placed on record duly sworn in Affidavit dated 18.08.2025.
The same is ordered to be taken on record.
Learned Advocate has submitted that matter has been amicably settled between the parties and there is no objection if present application is allowed.

The affidavit reads thus:
"5. I state and submit that, after filling a complaint due to intervention of family,
friends and elders of the community amicable settlement have been arrived between the parties for quashing and setting aside FIR being I-C.R. No. 89 of 2017 registered with Vidhya Nagar Police Station for the offences punishable under section 498A,
323, 504, 506(6) r/w 114 of IPC and s. 3 and 7 of Dowry Prohibition Act and S.
3(1)(r)(s) of Atrocities Act and all consequential proceeding arising out from the said FIR, and if the Hon'ble court is quashing the FIR on a ground of consent/settlement then I HAVE NO OBJECTIONS."
6. Considering averments made in the Affidavit as also the submissions made by the learned Advocates for the respective parties, the present application deserves to be allowed and is hereby allowed.
The FIR being CR No. I-89 of 2017 dated 18.06.2017 registered with Vidhyanagar Police Station, Anand is hereby quashed and set aside.
NEUTRAL CITATION R/SCR.A/4750/2017 ORDER DATED: 02/12/2025 undefined 6.1.
If the complainant has received any compensation from the State Government, the same shall be refunded to the concerned authoritY forthwith.

(M. R. MENGDEY,J) AHS Dignesh Kaushikbhai Desai vs State Of Gujarat on 2 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/3730098/
